title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Non-acceptance by People's Courts of a Protest Filed by a People's Procuratorate Solely against a Ruling on the Allocation of Litigation Costs

articles.content_en:
Higher People's Court of Henan Province:
We have received your Request (No. 131 [1998] of Higher People's Court of Henan Province) regarding whether a protest filed by a People's Procuratorate solely against a ruling on the burden of litigation costs may be accepted. Upon study, we agree with your opinion: a protest filed by a People's Procuratorate against a People's Court's ruling on the burden of litigation costs has no legal basis, and the People's Court shall not accept it.
This is a reply.
